config.title: AI Patch Apply
config.afterMaxBytes: Largest accepted AFTER block, in characters. Bigger blocks are rejected at parse time.
config.fuzzyMatch: Ignore tabs vs spaces and trailing whitespace when matching BEFORE.
config.pinDiffTabs: Pin diff tabs so they do not replace each other (VS Code preview mode).
config.focusFirstDiff: Focus the first diff tab instead of the last after preview.
config.failureThreshold: If the share of failed edits in a file is >= this value (and there are at least 2), the whole file is rejected. 0.4 = 40%.
command.acceptDiff: Accept Current Diff and Go to Next
